summary: Web-based app that loads real BTC historical data (free endpoint) and displays an interactive monthly candlestick chart with automated, dynamic liquidity level detection (horizontal lines + wick-based liquidity boxes) using consecutive opposite candle and breakout structure logic, with updated liquidity box lifecycle rules: untouched zones remain permanently visible until first touch, active zones (price inside / 1–3 candles) are highlighted, and only touched+cleared zones are removed (no time-based cleanup).
architectural_notes: Use a fast free public market data source (no API keys) for BTC/USD or BTC/USDT monthly OHLCV.
Timeframe is Monthly (1M) only for now; liquidity logic is designed specifically for 1M.
Improve BTC OHLCV data fetching robustness (handle endpoint outages/CORS/network failures) and switch to a more reliable free no-API-key data source chosen for speed/stability.

Liquidity boxes are now governed solely by price interaction: untouched boxes persist indefinitely until first touch; active boxes are highlighted while price is inside / 1–3 candles form inside; only touched+cleared boxes are removed; time alone must never remove a box.

Liquidity box rendering uses 3 explicit visual states (untouched/active/removed) applied symmetrically to upper and lower zones, with re-evaluation on each new monthly candle and safeguards to prevent duplicate/overlapping boxes.

Strict untouched-liquidity preservation patch: untouched liquidity boxes must always be created and remain visible/extended forward; remove ALL time/distance/structure-shift cleanup; only remove a box after confirmed touch (wick/body) AND clear displacement away; keep existing Active Market Box behavior (active when price inside or 1–3 candles form inside); apply symmetrically to upper/lower zones.
Implement additive override layer for liquidity lifecycle corrections (do not replace existing strict-untouched/active rules except where overrides apply).

Persist a 'completed liquidity zones' set keyed by (price range, direction, originating structure signature) to prevent re-creating zones that were touched+cleared, unless a new valid structure forms.
known_issues: BTC chart page shows 'failed to fetch data' error (started recently).
Some detected liquidity boxes that have NOT been touched by price are disappearing or not being plotted; must never be removed except after touch + displacement.
Some upper liquidity boxes remain visible or reappear after confirmed touch + clear displacement; should be permanently removed and blocked from recreation.
Some valid lower liquidity zones created by structure logic are missing/not plotted due to hidden filtering (e.g., distance/trend/structure suppression).

Specific missing/incorrectly highlighted untouched lower liquidity zone: ~$27k–$25k (should be auto-detected from two-opposite-candle wick-based structure and rendered in untouched/neutral style, but is being skipped/mis-classified).
Build/deployment pipeline intermittently fails with an internal configuration error ("Please report this error to the Caffeine team"), blocking shipping fixes.

existing_features.title: Fetch real BTC historical monthly OHLCV data from a fast free public endpoint (no API key) and expose it to the frontend in a stable format suitable for charting.
Render a fully interactive monthly (1M) candlestick chart and lock the UI to the Monthly timeframe (no timeframe switching).

Implement automated horizontal liquidity line detection and lifecycle on the monthly chart: (a) draw the initial horizontal line at the lower wick (low) of the first available monthly candle; (b) detect 'two consecutive opposite candles' against the current move and, when detected, draw a new horizontal line at the wick of the first opposite candle; (c) when price breaks a horizontal line, wait for the next two consecutive opposite candles and draw a new horizontal line at the wick of the first opposite candle; (d) keep only the most structurally relevant levels as the structure shifts forward.

Implement wick-based liquidity zone boxes (primary liquidity zones) derived from reversal structures, including the 'upper liquidity logic': (a) after detecting a reversal structure, compute the relevant wick range and draw a semi-transparent box that extends forward in time; (b) when a small opposite move forms inside a larger trend and then trend resumes, mark BOTH liquidity areas (at start of opposite candles and at end where trend resumes) using wick-based boxes; (c) manage both upper and lower liquidity zones using the same active/inactive logic.

Implement liquidity box invalidation and cleanup rules: (a) remove a box when price touches it AND then clearly moves away; (b) keep a box active if only 1–3 candles interact inside it and price is still moving inside/around it; (c) remove a box if it was touched long ago and price moved significantly far away and many candles formed since; (d) for upper liquidity, if price breaks above upper liquidity and fully clears it, remove that upper box; (e) inactive boxes must automatically disappear from the chart.

Apply visual styling for professional smart-money liquidity visualization: thin clean horizontal lines; semi-transparent liquidity boxes; distinct colors for active vs inactive (if an intermediate inactive state is shown); keep the chart visually clean by removing invalidated levels/zones.
Create and apply a coherent visual theme for the app (colors, typography, spacing, layout) that fits a financial charting tool aesthetic and is enforced consistently across the UI.

Replace the current CoinGecko-based monthly candle fetch (daily aggregation) with a faster and more reliable free public endpoint (no API key) that can return BTC monthly (1M) OHLCV directly, while keeping the frontend Candle format stable for charting.

Add resilient client-side fetching behavior for monthly candles to prevent intermittent endpoint failures from breaking the BTC chart page (timeout/abort, clearer error classification, and fallback to a secondary free public endpoint if the primary fails).
Update loading/error UI copy on the BTC chart page so it does not mention a specific provider (e.g., CoinGecko) and instead references “market data” generically.

Update the liquidity box lifecycle logic so that any liquidity box (upper or lower) that has not been touched by price remains permanently visible on the chart and is never removed due to time or distance alone; only price interaction may invalidate and remove a box.

Implement the new 'Active Market Box' behavior: if price is currently trading inside a liquidity box, or if price has recently entered and 1–3 candles are forming inside it, the box must remain visible and be marked as an Active Liquidity Zone distinct from untouched boxes.

Implement the 'Touched and Cleared Liquidity' invalidation rule: when price touches a liquidity box and then clearly moves away (strong displacement up or down) and the market is no longer interacting with it, the box becomes invalid and must be automatically removed from the chart; do not keep any faded history state for invalidated liquidity.

Update chart rendering and legend to support 3 distinct visual states for liquidity boxes: (1) Untouched = neutral (e.g., soft blue/gray), semi-transparent, thin border; (2) Active = strong highlight (e.g., yellow/orange), slightly higher opacity and clearer border; (3) Invalidated = not rendered.

Ensure liquidity box state evaluation is deterministic and performant: re-evaluate box status on each new monthly candle, update colors instantly on enter/exit, and avoid duplicate/overlapping boxes being rendered for the same price range and direction while preserving the existing base liquidity detection logic (consecutive opposite candles, breakout tracking, wick-based marking).

Enforce the strict untouched-liquidity preservation rule in the monthly BTC liquidity algorithm: any detected liquidity box (upper or lower) that has not been touched by price must always be created, must remain visible, and must never be removed due to time passed, distance from current price, structure shifts, or new liquidity forming elsewhere; only a confirmed touch followed by clear displacement away may invalidate and remove a box.

Preserve the existing 'Active Market Box' behavior while applying the strict untouched-preservation patch: a box must be visually marked as Active only when price is currently trading inside it or when price has recently entered and 1–3 candles are forming inside it; otherwise it should render in the neutral untouched style unless it has been invalidated (removed).

Fix any chart-rendering conditions that can cause a detected (and still-valid) liquidity box to not be plotted (e.g., start-index lookup failures). Ensure rendering is based on a deterministic, always-available reference to candle position (such as the box’s candleIndex) so a valid box cannot silently disappear due to timestamp/index mismatches.

Add a debug/verification check in the frontend liquidity computation path to guarantee: for every detected liquidity zone, if price_has_not_touched_zone is true then box_visibility is true. When this invariant is violated, emit a clear developer-facing warning (and include enough box identifiers/fields to diagnose) without breaking the UI.

Implement an additive override so that any liquidity box that has been touched and then clearly cleared by strong displacement is permanently invalidated (deleted) and must never reappear later in the chart for the same historical candles.

Add a “completed liquidity” registry inside the liquidity computation path that records the price range and direction (upper vs lower) of any touched+cleared liquidity zone, and use it to block recreation of the same price range unless a genuinely new valid structure produces a meaningfully different zone.

Ensure “valid structure detected + zone not invalidated” always results in a plotted liquidity box, with no suppression based on distance from current price, trend bias, new-structure replacement, or other implicit filtering; this must fix missing lower liquidity zones created by the two-consecutive-opposite-candles + wick-based reversal logic.

Update the liquidity box deduplication and lifecycle evaluation to avoid accidental suppression while still preventing true duplicates: never deduplicate away distinct non-cleared boxes that differ by candleIndex or materially differ in bounds; only remove boxes via explicit cleared/completed invalidation rules.

Fix the monthly BTC liquidity detection so the lower untouched liquidity zone around ~$27k–$25k (as shown/expected by the user) is automatically detected from the existing “two consecutive opposite candles → wick-based reversal structure” logic and returned in the liquidity model as a lower LiquidityBox with state='untouched' (until first touch).

Remove or adjust any reversal-structure detection constraints that can cause valid wick-based reversal structures to be missed on the monthly timeframe (e.g., reversal/opposite-move end detection that stops too early), ensuring the structure used to create the ~$27k–$25k lower zone is recognized reliably.

Add a developer-facing diagnostic warning (non-breaking) that triggers when a valid reversal structure is detected but no corresponding lower liquidity box is emitted, including enough identifiers (oppositeStartIndex, endIndex, computed wick range, intended box bounds) to diagnose why a zone would be skipped.

Fix the monthly BTC liquidity detection so the expected lower untouched liquidity zone around ~$27k–$25k is consistently emitted by the reversal-structure (two consecutive opposite candles → wick-based range) logic and appears in the computed liquidity model as a lower LiquidityBox with state='untouched' until first touch.

Fix the liquidity box lifecycle so untouched liquidity boxes (touchCount===0) are never removed, suppressed, or silently not plotted for any reason other than explicit touched+cleared invalidation rules (i.e., no time-based cleanup, distance filters, trend-bias suppression, or structural replacement may hide untouched boxes).

Ensure the chart rendering path deterministically maps each LiquidityBox to x-axis coordinates using candleIndex (not timestamps) and does not drop valid boxes due to start-index lookup failures; if candleIndex is out of bounds, clamp it and still render the box from the nearest valid candle to the latest candle.

Add a small, deterministic developer regression fixture for liquidity detection (a minimal hard-coded candle sequence) that reproduces the missing-lower-zone scenario and verifies: (1) a lower box is emitted, (2) it remains present when untouched, and (3) it only disappears after touched+cleared rules are met.

Implement wick-based liquidity zone boxes (upper and lower) derived from reversal structures, extending forward with active/inactive behavior

Update liquidity box lifecycle so untouched liquidity zones remain permanently visible until first price touch; remove time-based cleanup; remove boxes only when touched and clearly cleared (upper/lower symmetric)

Implement 3-state liquidity box visual system: untouched (neutral semi-transparent), active (highlight color/higher opacity when price inside or 1–3 candles), invalidated (auto-removed), with continuous re-evaluation each new monthly candle and no duplicate/overlapping boxes

Add additive override: permanently invalidate (delete) any liquidity box after confirmed touch + clear displacement; ensure invalidated zones never reappear as historical/ghost boxes
Track and persist a 'completed liquidity' registry (price range + direction) to block recreation of already touched+cleared zones unless a genuinely new valid structure forms

Additive override to force-plot any valid, non-invalidated liquidity zone created by structure logic (two consecutive opposite candles / wick-based reversal); remove any distance-from-price suppression

Remove/disable any silent filtering that suppresses liquidity zones (distance thresholds, new-structure suppression, trend-bias filtering); detection/visibility must be structure + invalidation-state based only
